Codes come with a Ko-fi thank-you. Folio checks a code on the phone against a key inside the app: it works with no signal, needs no account, and tells nobody that you supported.

Beta features arrive a release or two early, before they\'ve been through everyone\'s phones. Expect more bugs than usual — that\'s the trade. Turn this off whenever you like and Folio goes straight back to the way the stable release behaves.
Folio\'s core is free and stays free — Home, the island, panels, gestures and themes are never behind a code. Supporting buys time to keep building, and these extras are the thank-you.

Keyd is a keyboard for the rest of Folio: a separate app, because Android needs a keyboard to be its own input method. It splits around the crease of a fold, learns which words you fix, and asks for no internet permission. Your code already covers it — there is just nothing to install yet.
